title: Row sums
starter:
%A   = buffer 12 dtype=i32 slot=0
%out = buffer 3 dtype=i32 slot=1
# A is 3 rows of 4, row-major. out[i] = A[i*4+0] + ... + A[i*4+3].
# out starts with junk, so reset each out[i] first.
%i   = range 3
%j   = range 4
%i4  = mul %i 4
%ij  = add %i4 %j
%av  = shrink %A %ij shape=[]
%a   = load %av
%o   = shrink %out %i shape=[]
%cur = load %o
%sum = add %cur %a
%s   = store %o %sum
%ej  = end %s %j
%ei  = end %ej %i
%out1 = after %out %ei

hints: The starter adds into whatever `out` already holds. Where would a reset have to run?
The reset must run once per row: store 0 into `shrink %out %i` inside the i loop, then name that version with an `after` and accumulate into views of it.
Chain it: `%z = store %o 0`, `%out0 = after %out %z`, then the j loop loads and stores through `shrink %out0 %i`. Close j, then i, and sequence the outer loop with `after %out %ei`.

answer.code:
%A   = buffer 12 dtype=i32 slot=0
%out = buffer 3 dtype=i32 slot=1
%i   = range 3
%o   = shrink %out %i shape=[]
%z   = store %o 0
%out0 = after %out %z
%j   = range 4
%i4  = mul %i 4
%ij  = add %i4 %j
%av  = shrink %A %ij shape=[]
%a   = load %av
%o0  = shrink %out0 %i shape=[]
%cur = load %o0
%sum = add %cur %a
%s   = store %o0 %sum
%ej  = end %s %j
%ei  = end %ej %i
%out1 = after %out %ei
answer.explain: Each out[i] is reset by a store that depends on `%i`, so it runs once per row inside the i loop. The j loop then loads and stores the version after the reset. Its load is used only inside the j loop, which stores into that same version, so it's loop-carried and sees the running sum.
